items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 15 at 4:30AM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
items.description:
Patchy to areas fog will continue through sunrise across portions
of much of southeast Georgia and northeast Florida. Patchy dense
fog will likely develop with visibilities on area roadways
reduced to a quarter of a mile at times. Slow down and use caution
on the roadways if commuting this morning. The fog should lift
between 9 and 10 AM.
